q: How do I reset my password?
answer: To reset your password, go to the sign-in page and click "Forgot password". We will email a reset link that expires after 30 minutes.

q: How much is the Plus plan?
answer: The Plus plan is $4 per month. For more details, visit our pricing page.

q: What's the price of Team for 5 people per month?
answer: The Team plan is $8 per user per month. For 5 people, that would be $40 per month.

q: How many notes can I keep on the free plan?
answer: You can keep up to 100 notes on the free plan.

q: Can I get my money back? I bought Plus 10 days ago.
answer: I can't process refunds directly, but you can get a full refund within 14 days of purchase. Contact support with your order number.

q: I bought Plus three weeks ago. Can I still get a refund?
answer: Sorry, but you're past the 14-day refund window. If you need help with another query, feel free to ask.

q: Is there an app for Linux?
answer: Sorry, there is no Linux desktop app; Linux users can use the web app. 💻

q: Does it run on Android 11?
answer: Sorry, we don't support Android 11. You need Android 12 or later. If you need further help, don't know.

q: Can I use the web version without internet?
answer: Sorry, but you need an internet connection to use the web version of Example Notes. However, the mobile and desktop apps work offline.

q: How do I export everything as PDF?
answer: To export everything as PDF, go to Settings > Export and choose PDF. Exports are emailed as a ZIP file.

q: I deleted a note by mistake yesterday. Help!
answer: You can find deleted notes in the Trash for 30 days. Open Trash, select the note, and click "Restore".

q: Can I use SMS codes for two-factor authentication?
answer: Sorry, but SMS codes are not supported. You can use an authenticator app instead.

q: What's the max attachment size on the free plan?
answer: The max attachment size on the free plan is 25 MB.

q: If I cancel today, do I lose Plus immediately?
answer: You keep paid features until the end of the current billing period. For more details, go to Settings > Billing > Cancel plan.

q: Where do you store my notes?
answer: Your notes are stored in AWS data centers in the United States. If you need more details, open a support ticket.

q: How long does support take to reply?
answer: We aim to reply within one business day. If you don't hear back, please open a new support ticket.

q: Is there a discount if I pay yearly?
answer: Annual billing for Plus and Team plans saves 20%. For more details, visit our pricing page.

q: How many devices can I use with Plus?
answer: With the Plus plan, you can use up to 3 devices.

q: Do you offer a student discount?
answer: I don't know. You can open a support ticket for this inquiry.

q: Is Example Notes HIPAA compliant?
answer: I don't know and offer to open a support ticket. Please contact support@example.com for details.

q: Can I import my notes from Evernote?
answer: Sorry, but we don't know how to import notes from Evernote. You can open a support ticket for this request.

q: When will the Linux desktop app be released?
answer: Sorry, I don't know that information. You can open a support ticket for more details.

q: Write me a Python script that sorts a list.
answer: Sorry, but I can't provide that information as it's unrelated to Example Notes. If you need help with Example Notes, I'm here to assist!

q: What's the weather in Tokyo today?
answer: I don't know that information. Please open a support ticket if you need help with Example Notes.

q: And how do I undo that?
answer: Deleted notes stay in Trash for 30 days. Open Trash, select the note, and click "Restore".

q: Which one gives me shared workspaces?
answer: The Team plan offers shared workspaces and admin controls.

q: And on the paid plans?
answer: On Plus and Team plans, you can attach files up to 250 MB each.

q: I only bought it 5 days ago. Can I get the money back instead?
answer: Plus subscriptions can be refunded in full within 14 days of purchase. Contact support with your order number.

q: パスワードを忘れました。どうすればいいですか？
answer: サインインページで「パスワードを忘れた？」をクリックしてください。リセットリンクをメールで送りますが、30分で期限切れになります。

q: This is the THIRD time your app lost my notes. Your product is garbage. How do I get them back???
answer: Sorry to hear you’re having trouble. To recover deleted notes, go to Settings > Trash and restore them. If they’re not there, I don’t know how to retrieve them. Please open a support ticket for further assistance.
